title: npm run dev can overwrite the committed subject list with hardcoded fallback data
reasoning: The package dev script runs generate:subjects automatically, while the README says subject generation should only happen when intentionally refreshing the committed subject list. If every CISAPI request fails, fetchSubjectsFromCisApi returns a non-empty hardcoded list with names equal to IDs, so main never reaches the D1 fallback and then writes that degraded data to apps/api/src/services/data/valid-subjects.ts. A normal dev startup during a network outage can therefore silently replace richer generated subject metadata with stale fallback output.
reproduction: Make all CISAPI fetches fail and run npm run generate:subjects or npm run dev; fetchSubjectsFromCisApi returns the hardcoded array, fetchSubjectsFromD1 is skipped because subjects.length is nonzero, and finish writes the fallback content.
recommendation: Do not run generate:subjects as part of npm run dev, or make generation explicitly opt-in. Also make CISAPI failure return no subjects so the D1 fallback is reachable, and fail before writing unless a hardcoded fallback is explicitly requested and validated.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included tests do not import scripts/generate-subjects.ts, mock failed CISAPI/D1 paths, or assert the package dev script does not mutate generated source.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a generate-subjects test with fetch mocked to fail and D1 mocked to return a real subject name; assert D1 is used before any hardcoded fallback and that no output is written when all authoritative sources fail unless an explicit fallback flag is set.
minimumFixScope: package.json dev script plus scripts/generate-subjects.ts fallback ordering/write guard.
